deh.f: (Singlish, Manglish) Alternative spelling of dey (“informal term of address used when trying to get someone's attention.”).

s.g: (chemistry) The act or process of removing halogen (usually a pair of atoms) from a molecule; any reaction that does this.

(rare) Opening, gaping, in a general sense.
(medicine) Of or pertaining to dehiscence, i.e., a rupture, as with a surgical wound opening up, often with a flow of serous fluid.
(botany) Which dehisces or presents dehiscence.
(transitive) To remove the horns from.
